newsitem.title: UK: Gen Accident awaiting NJ insurance meeting.
newsitem.headline: Gen Accident awaiting NJ insurance meeting.

text.p: British insurer General Accident Plc said on Wednesday it was still awaiting a meeting with the New Jersey insurance commissioner who said in early March GA could be fined up to $1 million for insurance violations in the U.S.

A report in the Financial Times on Wednesday said GA shares had been hit on Tuesday by news of the fine and possible suspension in New Jersey, yet GA pointed out that the ruling had first been issued on March 6.

The spokesman declined comment on the New Jersey ruling, which means that GA and its Camden Fire Insurance Co unit could have their authorisation to do business in New Jersey suspended for car insurance violations.
He said GA believed it was "inappropriate to comment" while it was awaiting further legal developments, adding that the company expected a meeting with the commissioner to discuss the issue.
The spokesman said he was not aware of any likely timescale for the meeting and said he was not in a position to comment on the nature of the violations.
In a weak insurance sector GA shares were down 22-1/2p at 799-1/2 by 1405 GMT, after on Tuesday dropping 17-1/2p.
